web/src/features/projects: Quick-open, which the projects feature supplies to the root, lists the library and its items beside the projects, and the dashboard links to the library.
web/src/features/decisions: A take choice's candidate can be a range of a library item, which the decisions screen plays from the library with sound and picture.
web/src/features/pause-rig: The pause rig plays lines from several library items, reading each item and its transcript as the item screen does.
